scientific_integrity: The global bound follows from an analytic argument for all positive integer orders; finite computational tests serve only as reproducibility checks. General Cayley/resolvent positivity criteria are acknowledged prior results; source-access and publication-priority limitations are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected complete multipartite graphs only; unit vertex masses and equal positive edge conductance at fixed total budget; exact arithmetic; no guarantee for other graphs, unequal edge allocations, discretization accuracy or nonlinear diffusion.
title: A smallest-prime-factor law for Crank–Nicolson positivity on budgeted multipartite networks
